subject.title: fix(auto-reply): preserve Unicode in context treemap label truncation

question: Should the context treemap remain intentionally ASCII-sanitized, or should it begin supporting Unicode labels end-to-end?
rationale: The submitted code changes only a dormant private-helper case while the stated production path removes Unicode first, so the intended output contract cannot be inferred from the patch alone.

options.title: Keep the ASCII contract
options.body: Close or narrow this speculative helper hardening and retain the existing sanitizer behavior until a user-facing Unicode-label requirement exists.

options.title: Support Unicode labels end-to-end
options.body: Update the sanitizer/rendering contract and add focused context-treemap proof showing Unicode labels are intentionally displayed without malformed truncation.

recommendation.title: Keep the ASCII contract
recommendation.body: Close or narrow this speculative helper hardening and retain the existing sanitizer behavior until a user-facing Unicode-label requirement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The identified introduction commit is the only concrete provenance signal for the affected helper.
